Disconnetion Document - Structure

Reconnection Order Generation

Use

You use this function to generate reconnection orders. A reconnection order is an object that contains the reconnection details for
devices that are to be reconnected.

Remote Reconnections in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Environment

If you are working in an advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) environment, you can configure the reconnection order for the
remote reconnection of AMI devices (such as smart meters or advanced meters). For more information, see Advanced Metering
Infrastructure .

Integration
Generating Customer Notifications
